facts.business: Supreme Engineering Limited is engaged in engineering operations with revenue from domestic and export markets.

auditor.name: RUSHABH DAVDA & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company does not have an adequate internal financial control system over financial reporting commensurate with the size and nature of its business. The Company has also not appointed an internal auditor as required under Section 138 of the Companies Act, 2013. The Company has used Tally Prime, an accounting software, for maintaining its books of account; however, the feature of recording audit trail (edit log) at the database level was not enabled during the year, and hence the system did not maintain logs of direct data modifications. The Company does not have formal written Standard Operating Manuals (SOPs) or documented procedures in place to ensure consistency, efficacy, and effectiveness of its internal financial controls.

key_risks: Inadequate internal financial control system over financial reporting
Non-appointment of internal auditor as required under Section 138 of the Companies Act, 2013
Lack of audit trail (edit log) at database level in accounting software (Tally Prime)
Absence of formal written Standard Operating Manuals (SOPs) or documented procedures for internal financial controls
